articles.title: India-Myanmar naval exercise "IMNEX-26" commences in Visakhapatnam
articles.description: The 8th edition of the India-Myanmar Naval Exercise (IMNEX-26) commenced in Visakhapatnam and will continue until November 14, with the participation of naval ships from both countries, the Indian Navy said.

articles.title: India-Myanmar Naval Exercise IMNEX-26 Begins in Visakhapatnam
articles.description: The 8th edition of the India-Myanmar Naval Exercise IMNEX-26 began in Visakhapatnam, with Myanmar Navy Ship UMS King Sin Phyu Shin joining INS Rana and INS Sumedha.

articles.title: 8th Edition of India-Myanmar Naval Exercise Commences at Visakhapatnam
articles.description: The 8th India-Myanmar Naval Exercise (IMNEX-26) has begun in Visakhapatnam. The bilateral event aims to boost maritime cooperation, professional expertise, and tactical interoperability between the Indian and Myanmar navies.
